verdict.rationale: The evidence shows the source is publicly readable on GitHub. Users can build from source by cloning the repo, community users report compiling from source, and contributors can open PRs. However, nothing in the pack names the license, so the 'open license' half of the story is only implied. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of the license terms (e.g. a LICENSE file or a named OSI license), independent confirmation of licensing.
